title: Campbell's father's anecdotes about musicians
summary: A funny story about a saxophone player told to Campbell by his father.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: A lot of this stuff I'm talking about is well before my time but my father used to sit down and rap with me and I used to go to rehearsal with my dad, oh, yeah.
Do you remember any more stories, you know, anecdotes that he used to tell you?

Well, I'm going to tell you -- I can't remember the name, but I'm going to tell you something funny. A saxophone player went to see a friend that was sick and this friend that was sick had cancer. So when the saxophone player got to the house he took him a basket of fruit, but he used to like to taste them up a bit. So he asked him, could he send out and get a jug. So he sent out and got a jug and he got so high, guess what. The guy he went out to see got out of his sick bed and took him home.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
